text:
nina_oncall: Heads-up — our weekly snapshot scan flagged ~120 objects missing 'snapshot.provenance' metadata across prod-db replicas.

mike_dbops: on it. Which buckets/regions?

nina_oncall: s3://redwood-prod-db-backups/us-west-2 and replicated copies in eu-west-1. Pattern looks recent — started ~3 days ago per retention logs.

sara_sec: :eyes: any indication of KMS/CMEK involvement? missing provenance could be metadata-stripping or uploader bug.

mike_dbops: preliminary: the objects are encrypted SSE-CMK (customer-managed). KMS logs show repeated DECRYPT grants around 2026-03-18 04:xx UTC for the uploader role, followed by PutObject without x-amz-meta keys.

karen_infra: the upload path is backup-agent -> multipart upload -> finalize. There's a midstream rehydration path that touches the metadata map. I'll trace.

tom_devrel: is this user-facing? customers might notice restore failures without provenance.

nina_oncall: We saw two restore attempts return 'missing provenance metadata' alerts (internal). No customer-facing outage yet but potential.

encops-bot: Alert: 120 files flagged. Severity: medium. Suggested action: quarantine and run metadata recovery if possible. (runbook: https://internal/runbooks/encops/snapshot-provenance)

sara_sec: Important: check KMS grant expiry windows. If grants expired during multipart finalize, agent might have retried with a fallback that omits metadata.

mike_dbops: I queried CloudAuditLogs: there were short-lived grants issued via KMS GenerateDataKey (GrantId=gr-1387) with TTL 5m. One grant expiry collided with finalize step for ~18 uploads.

karen_infra: That's suspicious — we recently rolled a change to IAM principal scoping for the backup-agent role (PR #3221). Could be missing iam:PutObjectTagging or metadata permissions.

tom_devrel: Is metadata written as object headers or separate tagging? That affects which permission is needed.

mike_dbops: We set x-amz-meta-snapshot-provenance in the final PutObject call headers. PutObject requires s3:PutObject and the headers are client-side; no extra S3 permission needed beyond PutObject. But our finalize path sometimes uses S3 CopyObject to set metadata when server-side reassembly happens — that requires s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl in some flows.

sara_sec: Ok. Two vectors: 1) KMS grant expiry causing agent to take a fallback path that doesn't include metadata; 2) IAM scoping removed a small permission the copy/finalize step needs. Both plausible.

nina_oncall: Action items: mike/karen to confirm which code path executed for affected timestamps, sara to confirm KMS grant TTLs and whether grant renewal logic is buggy, tom to prepare comms if customer restores are impacted.

mike_dbops: I'll dump backup-agent logs for those timestamps and grep for 'CopyObject' and 'SetMetadata' entries. Command I'll run: 

```
rg "FinalizeUpload|CopyObject|SetMetadata|snapshot-provenance" /var/log/backup-agent/2026-03-18*
```

karen_infra: I'll cross-check the deploy that rolled PR #3221 — timestamp and which instances got the new IAM role. Quick check: deploy-2026-03-17T23:50 changed role to 'backup-agent-scoped-v2'. Rolling back is possible but heavy.

sara_sec: KMS side — I see a pattern: grants issued via sts:AssumeRole for ephemeral worker sessions with Grant TTL 300s. There was a spike in GC of grants on 2026-03-18 04:12:20 which aligns.

nina_oncall: Could it be a race where the client requested data key, got it, but finalize took >5m waiting on replication ack and then retried under fallback using server-side copy that didn't include original headers?

mike_dbops: Exactly. We have a known issue where large uploads that use multipart finalize via CopyObject can lose custom headers unless CopyObjectMetadata directive is explicit. I recall a bug in the agent that defaulted to REPLACE instead of COPY in some error flows.

tom_devrel: Is there a small fix we can ship to ensure metadata preserved by default? Even a hotfix to set MetadataDirective=COPY on CopyObject would help.

karen_infra: We can patch agent and roll to a subset (canary) of uploaders. But we also need to remediate existing objects — try to reconstruct provenance from manifest DB.

mike_dbops: Manifest DB has entries for all backups including provenance payload (uploader version, commit ID, start time). For ~80% of affected objects we can reconstruct and add metadata via S3 CopyObject with MetadataDirective=REPLACE to apply x-amz-meta-snapshot-provenance.

sara_sec: Before touching objects: ensure IAM policy allows our remediation principal to write metadata and that we audit all changes. Also create a signed manifest of changes for compliance.

nina_oncall: Timeline proposal:
- Next 30m: karen + mike confirm code path and reproduce locally (non-prod)
- 2h: sara verify KMS grant behavior and propose TTL fix (increase or renew on finalize)
- 4h: remediation job to repair metadata for recoverable objects (with audit log)
- 24h: rollout agent hotfix with explicit MetadataDirective=... and add unit test; follow canary.

karen_infra: Ack. I'll also check token exchange flow for backup-agent to see if a retry/backoff extended beyond grant TTL.

mike_dbops: Quick results: logs show 173 finalize entries that hit CopyObject with no metadata header. 112 of those have manifest rows. I'll start remediation script (dry-run) and post diffs.

sara_sec: For postmortem / compliance notes: capture why grant TTL was 5m (was to limit blast radius), and propose a design change: renew grant during finalize or set TTL to 15m for finalize-prone flows.

tom_devrel: I'll draft a short customer-facing note template in case any restore jobs fail; minimal risk but good to prepare.

encops-bot: Runbook step started by mike_dbops: metadata_repair_dryrun_5612347890. Status: running.

nina_oncall: If remediation writes new metadata via CopyObject REPLACE, we must ensure server-side encryption headers (SSE-CMK) are preserved and KMS access used — coordinate with sara/karen.

sara_sec: Right. Our remediation principal will call CopyObject specifying x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms and x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id same CMK; we need active grants or permanent permission for remediation role.

karen_infra: I'll create a short-lived remediation role with a scoped inline policy and a KMS Grant that lasts 1h. We'll log grant creation and destruction.

mike_dbops: Dry-run completed: 112 candidates, preview shows we can reconstruct provenance for 96 objects. 16 missing manifest rows — need deeper investigation.

nina_oncall: For the 16: escalate to incident review. sara, can you check if any of those correspond to tenants with stricter CMK separation (per-tenant keys)?

sara_sec: On it. If per-tenant CMKs differ, remediation might require tenant-specific grants — that'll slow remediation but manageable.

tom_devrel: Also add a monitoring rule: alert when PutObject with SSE-CMK occurs without snapshot.provenance header more than X times in 1h.

karen_infra: I'll add that to logging pipeline. Query: cloudwatch metric or log-based alert?

nina_oncall: log-based alert on ingestion is fine, threshold 5 in 30m for now.

mike_dbops: Starting remediation run (non-destructive, will not replace encryption). I'll post results.

encops-bot: metadata_repair_dryrun_5612347890 finished. 96 recoverable, 16 needs-manual. Report: https://internal/reports/5612347890

sara_sec: Good work team. We'll treat as incident candidate if any customer restores fail. Postmortem checklist: root cause (TTL & agent copy fallback), detection time, remediation steps, code fix PR, IAM/KMS policy changes, monitoring.

nina_oncall: Closing loop: please update the runbook with the new remediation flow and the alert condition. I'll file an incident ticket if any manual cases require customer contact.

mike_dbops: PR for agent hotfix coming in ~3h. Will include unit test and e2e that simulates grant expiry mid-finalize.

tom_devrel: I'll prep the blurb for status page if needed.

sara_sec: One more: let's add an audit tag to repaired objects like x-amz-meta-repaired-by=encops-2026-03-18 to avoid confusion later.

karen_infra: Agreed. We'll include that in remediation script and log entries.

nina_oncall: Thanks all. Update channel when remediation completes and when agent canary passes.

mike_dbops: Will do.
